_about: What `tools\cli economy` cannot read from a config for the mining chains (#3240, E1 of #3206): gather rates, haul distances, vehicle loads. Everything the configs hold (recipes in Configs/Resources/ResourceChains.conf, wholesale curves in market.goods, hardware premium rows in buyerDemand.rows) is read from them, not repeated here. Numbers are the design note's (mining-chains.md, 2026-11-18) with the real map distances between the sites; #3246 (E2) tunes them from measured rates. A distance is straight-line km, driven at minutesPerKm.

vehicles._about: Load per trip. sacks: whole sacks the cargo bed or shoulder holds (#3265 pickup 6, truck 12; #3263 shoulder carry). looseUnits: loose items a car boot holds (a car bed holds no sacks).
